title: "AEGIS Kapk: try aligning cry2 to other plant species"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# install.packages("BiocManager")
# BiocManager::install("ggmsa")

library(ggmsa)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

fasta_file <- "../results/AT1G04400_aligned.fa"

# zoomed to a region (start/end are alignment column positions)
ggmsa(fasta_file, 
      start = 460, 
      end = 510, 
      color = "LETTER", 
      font = 'helvetical',
      seq_name = F, 
      #position_highlight = c(469, 484, 501), 
      ignore_gaps = T, 
      char_width = 0,
      show.legend = T) +
  geom_msaBar()

ggsave("../results/AT1G04400_msa_view.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)

```
